spanish: Y llamó el rey de Egipto a las que hacen dar a luz, y dijo a ellas: ¿Por qué hicieron ustedes esta palabra, y hicieron vivir a los hijos?
grammarChanges: Repaired cited fail on h02001018008/h02001018011: 'hicieron' alone reads as 3rd-person plural (ellas); inserted the explicit 2nd-person formal pronoun 'ustedes' so the qal perfect 2fp עֲשִׂיתֶן and the piel sequential imperfect 2fp וַתְּחַיֶּיןָ are both read as the king addressing the midwives directly, without changing the verb forms (Latin American ustedes shares morphology with 3rd plural; vosotros forms not used).
Added the definite article 'el' before 'rey de Egipto' (h02001018002/h02001018003) for Spanish grammaticality; no change to participants or sense.
